dimensions.obligation_correctness: The answer recovers repeated polling, foreground lifecycle invalidation, generation binding, and the background ownership contrast.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: The answer grounds claims in the foreground preparation flow, the workspace-owned background flow, and the transport/scheduler boundary, citing README.md, src/Workspace.vue and src/session.js.
dimensions.failure_prediction: The answer predicts lost polling, completion after close, stale-generation delivery, duplicate delivery, or unauthorized background cancellation.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: The answer does not assume that every visually closed surface owns and cancels its underlying work.

obligations.statement: Pending preparation must schedule another check, remain loading, and deliver exactly once only after ready.
obligations.event_relation: Every pending status precedes another check; the first ready status precedes one delivery.
obligations.failure_if_violated: The task stops after one pending response, delivers too early, or delivers more than once.

obligations.statement: Closing the download dialog invalidates timers and in-flight responses; reopening creates a distinct generation.
obligations.event_relation: Close or reopen advances the lifecycle generation before any earlier response may mutate state.
obligations.failure_if_violated: A closed dialog resumes polling, delivers late, or an old response wins after reopen.

obligations.statement: Without broader authorization, closing the background panel must not cancel its workspace-owned export.
obligations.event_relation: Panel close may precede pending and ready statuses without invalidating background work.
obligations.failure_if_violated: A shared dialog-style fix silently cancels an adjacent background export.
